ev.q: Tutenstein is an American animated television series
premiered on Discovery Kids' Saturday morning block on NBC
The resolutions of the stories are fairly predictable
The character of Tut is amusing, with his combination of childishness and egotism
Tut meets up with a 12 year old girl, Cleo, and his trusty companion, Luxor
his interaction with Cleo and Luxor can be quite funny
